escena: SCENE (street shoot seen from above, Roma Norte in Mexico City, golden hour): low sun rakes down the street and a light haze hangs in the air, turning the gaps between buildings into visible beams; from a balcony four floors up, a small film crew works around a taco stand, and the moment caught is the director raising her arm to call action while a passing cyclist crosses the frame. Only a narrow horizontal band across the crew is sharp, everything above and below melts into a soft blur that makes the street look like a miniature. Nobody looks up at the camera. Tilt-shift lens at 45 degrees down, sharp plane on the crew. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus balcony railing right against the lens
